rule:
(all on the pilot seeds; "baseline" = v2.1 on the same seed and condition):
  D1 effectiveness: weak conditions = cyclic 0.5 / 0.8 / 0.9 and targeted flip 0.2 —
     every (condition, seed): accuracy >= baseline - 0.5; mean gain over the 8 cells >= +2.0 points.
  D2 no clean cost: clean accuracy >= baseline - 0.5; clean honest rejection <= baseline + 5 points.
  D3 integrity kept: backdoor 0.4 conditional ASR <= baseline + 5; boosted backdoor 0.4 ASR <= baseline + 5
     and accuracy >= baseline - 1.
Choice: among variants passing D1-D3, the simplest in the order N, V, NV. None passes -> keep v2.1.
    python audit/choose_agg.py -> results_r02/calibration/agg_variant.json
